subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Predict what will happen in a story from the pictures.
Find details in the story The Space Race.
Give your opinion about the characters and the story.

tf.s: Faisal and Hazim are dressed as astronauts.
The class is learning about the solar system in Science.
tf.why: Their Science topic is the solar system.

tf.s: Hazim falls over because he sees a squirrel in the tree.
tf.why: He looks up at the squirrel and falls.

tf.s: Faisal says: "I'll win, but I won't enjoy the race."
tf.why: Faisal says: I won't win, but I'll enjoy the race.
Faisal is kind and gives Hazim his helmet.

tf.s: The boys think only one person won the race.
tf.why: They say they all won because they finished together.

tf.s: Faisal thinks enjoying the race is more important than winning.
tf.why: He enjoys the race even if he doesn't win.

tf.s: Hazim falls over because his shoes are too big.
tf.why: He falls because he looks up at a squirrel.

tf.s: "Stars" and "planets" end with the same sound.
tf.why: stars ends with /z/ and planets ends with /s/.

tf.s: The boys finish the race together.
tf.why: They finish together, so they say they all won.

boxes.q: Who are Faisal and Hazim dressed as?
What does Hazim see in the tree?
What is the class learning about in Science?
boxes.why: They are learning about the solar system.

boxes.q: Why do the boys say they all won?
boxes.why: Finishing together made them all winners.

boxes.q: Which word is a story word?
boxes.why: The boys wear costumes in the race.

boxes.q: Complete: I ______ win, but I'll enjoy the race.
boxes.why: I won't win = I will not win.

boxes.q: What do astronauts wear on their heads?
boxes.why: A helmet keeps the head safe.

boxes.q: What is the name of Graded reader 2?
boxes.why: Graded reader 2 is The New Telescope.

hunt.q: Faisal and Hazim are dressed as
I won't win, but I'll ___ it
Clothes for a party or play

mcq.q: What is the name of this story?
mcq.why: Graded reader 1 is The Space Race.

o: He looks up at a squirrel in the tree.
mcq.why: He sees a squirrel and looks up.

mcq.q: Which words are from the story?
What does Faisal say about the race?
o: I won't win, but I'll enjoy the race.
I won't run in the race.
mcq.why: Faisal wants to enjoy the race.

mcq.q: Your friend needs help in a race. What would a good friend do?
o: Help him, like Faisal helps Hazim.
mcq.why: Faisal helps his friend by giving him his helmet.

mcq.q: Which plural has the same ending sound as "stars"?
Before reading, you look at the pictures and say what will happen. What are you doing?
mcq.why: Predicting means guessing what will happen.

mcq.q: Faisal says, "I won't win, but I'll enjoy the race." What does this tell you about him?
o: He thinks enjoying the race is more important than winning.
He wants to stop the race.
mcq.why: He is happy to take part even if he doesn't win.

mcq.q: Who won the race, in the boys' opinion?
o: They all won, because they finished together.
mcq.why: Finishing together made them all winners.

mcq.q: What is the main message of the story?
o: Helping friends and enjoying the race matter more than winning.
mcq.why: The boys help each other and enjoy the race.
